agent_run_timestamps_check.name: agent_run_timestamps_check
agent_run_timestamps_check.value:
(
      ("agent_run"."status" = 'queued' and "agent_run"."started_at" is null and "agent_run"."settled_at" is null)
      or ("agent_run"."status" = 'running' and "agent_run"."started_at" is not null and "agent_run"."settled_at" is null)
      or ("agent_run"."status" in ('completed', 'failed', 'aborted', 'interrupted') and "agent_run"."settled_at" is not null)
    )

agent_run_completed_check.name: agent_run_completed_check
agent_run_completed_check.value:
"agent_run"."status" != 'completed' or (
      "agent_run"."assistant_message_id" is not null and "agent_run"."config_snapshot" is not null
      and "agent_run"."started_at" is not null and "agent_run"."stop_reason" is not null and "agent_run"."stop_reason" = 'stop'
      and "agent_run"."error_code" is null and "agent_run"."error_message" is null
    )

agent_run_failed_check.name: agent_run_failed_check

agent_run_input_disposition_check.name: agent_run_input_disposition_check
agent_run_input_disposition_check.value:
(
      ("agent_run_input"."disposition" = 'pending' and "agent_run_input"."delivered_at" is null)
      or ("agent_run_input"."disposition" = 'delivered' and "agent_run_input"."delivered_at" is not null)
    )

directory_observation_result_check.name: directory_observation_result_check
directory_observation_result_check.value: ("directory_observation"."kind" = 'accessible' and "directory_observation"."real_path" is not null and "directory_observation"."reason" is null and length("directory_observation"."real_path") between 1 and 4096 and substr("directory_observation"."real_path", 1, 1) = '/' and instr("directory_observation"."real_path", char(0)) = 0) or ("directory_observation"."kind" = 'unavailable' and "directory_observation"."real_path" is null and "directory_observation"."reason" is not null and "directory_observation"."reason" in ('missing', 'not_directory', 'denied', 'io_error'))

machine_connection_status_check.name: machine_connection_status_check
machine_connection_status_check.value: ("machine_connection"."status" = 'open' and "machine_connection"."closed_at" is null) or ("machine_connection"."status" = 'closed' and "machine_connection"."closed_at" is not null)

machine_connection_payload_check.name: machine_connection_payload_check
machine_connection_payload_check.value: ("machine_connection"."seq" = 0 and "machine_connection"."capability" is null and "machine_connection"."last_payload_hash" is null) or ("machine_connection"."seq" > 0 and "machine_connection"."capability" is not null and "machine_connection"."last_payload_hash" is not null and length("machine_connection"."last_payload_hash") = 64 and "machine_connection"."last_payload_hash" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')

machine_capability_json_check.name: machine_capability_json_check
machine_capability_json_check.value: case when "machine_connection"."capability" is null then 1 when json_valid("machine_connection"."capability") then json_type("machine_connection"."capability") = 'object' else 0 end

machine_secret_hash_check.name: machine_secret_hash_check
machine_secret_hash_check.value: "machine_credential"."secret_hash" is null or (length("machine_credential"."secret_hash") = 64 and "machine_credential"."secret_hash" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')

machine_activation_check.name: machine_activation_check
machine_activation_check.value: ("machine_credential"."secret_hash" is null and "machine_credential"."activated_at" is null) or ("machine_credential"."secret_hash" is not null and "machine_credential"."activated_at" is not null)

project_machine_directory_check.name: project_machine_directory_check
project_machine_directory_check.value: "project_machine"."directory" is null or (length("project_machine"."directory") between 1 and 4096 and substr("project_machine"."directory", 1, 1) = '/' and instr("project_machine"."directory", char(0)) = 0)
